summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs header, shuffled string-array rotator, hex-mangled identifiers) that is unrelated to an ESLint configuration package. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex-mangled identifiers (_0x488df8, _0x52943e) and wrapper-object indirection around fs, https, execFileSync, and unzip calls. On npm install, an alternate language runtime is fetched solely to execute an opaque payload that Node-based tooling does not inspect, giving attacker-controlled code execution on the installer's host at install time. The @ornikar/eslint-config-react name resembles a legitimate ESLint config, but the shipped preinstall behavior and payload do not match that stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
